topic: Percentage Increase/Decrease • RRB Group D Level-1 (11 Aug 2026 Shift 19)

question.en: The income of Raman is ₹70,900. He saves 12% of his income. If his income increases by 39% and expenditure increases by 50%, then his savings will:
question.hi: रमन की आय ₹70,900 है। वह अपनी आय के 12% की बचत करता है। यदि उसकी आय में 39% की वृद्धि होती है और व्यय में 50% की वृद्धि होती है , तो उसकी बचत में ____________ हो जाएगी।

solution.approach: Official Answer: Option C (**decrease by ₹3,545**).
solution.keyConcept: Direct Change Law: ΔSavings = ΔIncome − ΔExpenditure

optionTrick.en: Notice net $\%$ change in income = $+39\%$, while expenditure change on whole income = $-\frac{88}{100} \times 50\%$. That gives direct Net Factor $= -5\%$ of ₹70,900 $= \mathbf{Rs.3,545}$!
optionTrick.hi: आय वृद्धि $= +39\%$ तथा आय के सापेक्ष व्यय वृद्धि $= 88\% \times 50\% = 44\%$ — दोनों का अंतर ही ₹70,900 पर सीधी कमी ($\mathbf{Rs.3,545}$) है!

trapAlert.en: Never waste 60 seconds calculating New Income and New Expenditure first! Only compute ΔI and ΔE and take ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (positive = increase, negative = decrease).
trapAlert.hi: पुरानी-नई आय अलग से निकालकर 60 सेकंड बर्बाद न करें; सीधे $\Delta\text{बचत} = \Delta\text{आय} - \Delta\text{व्यय}$ सूत्र से चिह्न (+ वृद्धि / − कमी) तय करें।

title.en: Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec)
title.hi: विधि 2: स्मार्ट Δबचत = Δआय − Δव्यय ट्रिक

solution.en:
Method 1: Basic Income-Expenditure Table: 1) Old Savings $= 12\%$ of ₹70,900 = **₹8,508**; Old Expenditure $= 88\%$ of ₹70,900 = **₹62,392**.
2) New Income ($+39\%$) = **₹98,551**; New Expenditure ($+50\%$) = **₹93,588**.
3) New Savings $= Rs.98,551 - Rs.93,588 = Rs.4,963$.
4) Change $= Rs.4,963 - Rs.8,508 \Rightarrow$ **Decrease of ₹3,545**.

Method 2: Smart ΔS = ΔI − ΔE (12 sec): 1) $\Delta I = +39\%$ of ₹70,900 = **+₹27,651**.
2) $E = 88\% \times Rs.70,900 = Rs.62,392$, so $\Delta E = +50\% \times Rs.62,392 = +Rs.31,196$.
3) $\Delta S = Rs.27,651 - Rs.31,196 = -Rs.3,545 \Rightarrow$ **Decrease by ₹3,545**.

steps.hi: मानक रेलवे प्रमेय: यदि $\cos\theta + \sin\theta = \sqrt{2}\cos\theta$, तो $\cos\theta - \sin\theta$ सदैव $\mathbf{\sqrt{2}\sin\theta}$ होता है!

solution.en:

3) $x^2 = 2(1 - \cos^2\theta) = 2\sin^2\theta \Rightarrow x = \mathbf{\sqrt{2}\sin\theta}$.

solution.hi:

2) $2\cos^2\theta + x^2 = 2 \Rightarrow x^2 = 2(1 - \cos^2\theta) = 2\sin^2\theta$।
3) अतः $x = \mathbf{\sqrt{2}\sin\theta}$।
